ambiguities.aspect: reset/initial values of count and wave_out
readings: No reset or power-up value is specified: count may start at 0 and wave_out at 0, giving a defined first half-period and initial polarity.
count and wave_out may be unknown until first toggle, or may use other initial values, changing the first toggle edge and output phase/polarity.
Toggle when count == freq - 1, as stated in 'When count reaches (freq - 1)'; half-period length is freq clk cycles.
Toggle when count == freq, as implied by 'If count has not reached freq'; half-period length is freq+1 clk cycles.
Treat freq=0 as invalid: no toggling, hold wave_out, or undefined behavior.
8-bit freq-1 underflows to 255, so count reaches 255 and toggles every 256 clk cycles; or if comparing to freq, count==0 toggles every clk cycle.
Compare count against the current freq each clk, so a mid-period change can shorten/lengthen the current half-period or prevent equality until counter wrap.
Latch freq at the start of each half-period (or only apply new freq after next toggle), so the current half-period completes at the old rate.
